$comment: Local recognisers, measured 2 September 2026 on 200 voice-agent clips from pipecat-ai/stt-benchmark-data and re-checked against 162 accented EdAcc clips. parakeet-tdt wins on accuracy, throughput and end-of-speech latency and is the default. nemotron-3.5 reaches a first partial 1.8 seconds sooner. kyutai-1b is the only one that ends a turn on meaning rather than on a timer, which is worth roughly 0.9 seconds of turn-taking and is why it is carried despite losing on every other number. See docs/evals/stt-voice-agent-2026-09-02.md.

engines.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B
engines.description: Most accurate and the fastest to finish. Waits about three seconds before its first partial.

engines.name: Nemotron 3.5 Streaming 0.6B
engines.description: First words about 1.8 seconds sooner, for roughly four points more word error.

engines.name: Kyutai STT 1B
engines.description: Ends a turn when you sound finished rather than after a fixed pause -- about 0.9 seconds sooner in practice. Less accurate than the other two and uses most of the graphics card.
